2026-10-22

Summarized by gemini-3.7-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-10-22

Overview

Summary of 1032 commits processed on the main branch for October 22, 2026, with 833 relevant changes targeting Windows and macOS embedders. Spanning from (b7b54b5) to (a550a6f).

Core Embedder & Architecture

  • ⚠️content::DocumentService now inherits from base::SelfDeleting, eliminating direct manual delete this patterns and requiring a base::SelfDeletingPassKey in constructors with MakeSelfDeleting instantiation. (1740410)
  • Removed legacy max mapping size, message number, and shared memory size limits from mojo::core::Configuration as modern mojo-ipcz no longer enforces these limits. (b986854)
  • Added Rust bindings for url::Origin (scheme and serialize methods) and GURL, facilitating safe migration of core child process security checks. (332f889) (54bdb3f) (50c0c95)

Security & Data Protection

  • Clipboard operations now enforce strict origin-cleanliness checks before exporting bitmaps or data URLs, disabling copy commands on tainted cross-origin canvases. (6778fee) (dedf2af)
  • Added explicit browser process validation to DOMStorageContextWrapper namespace and storage area bindings, dropping invalid messages from compromised renderers. (02dc3d4)
  • Expanded File System Access API blocklists to prevent write access to sensitive system paths like .git configurations and shell startup files. (d6f2c70)
  • Hardened CRX extension unpacking with UnzipFilesystemImpl, restricting file opens to create-only mode and purging existing targets before writing manifests or hashes. (7a0c3ee)

Browser UI & Desktop Experience

  • Restricted Most Recently Used (MRU) tab switching via Ctrl+Tab strictly to the currently focused browser window's TabStripModel, eliminating cross-monitor focus jumps. (6d33681)
  • Enabled LensSidePanelUnification and ContextualTasksSidePanel by default across desktop platforms to streamline side panel task coordination. (4061337)
  • Introduced dedicated devtools://devtools-remote host for remote DevTools frontends to isolate origin-scoped storage from bundled application files. (9012c26)

Networking & Media

  • Added a memory-safe Rust implementation of HttpChunkedDecoder under net/http/ behind the kRustHttpChunkedDecoder feature flag. (ac8c74c)
  • Integrated MediaFoundation video capture on Windows to stream frames through shared-image pools instead of raw DXGI GpuMemoryBuffer handles. (3e5db22) (9ab4a36)
  • Enforced requirement that web-facing Dawn OpenGL backends must use Chrome's ANGLE pipeline to guarantee driver workarounds. (a3e21e5)

Performance & Base Utilities

  • Migrated mojo::InterfaceEndpointClient internal lookup maps from std::map to absl::flat_hash_map to reduce query overhead. (6c1a689)
  • Gated base::Lock and thread checking ownership tracking on EXPENSIVE_DCHECKS_ARE_ON, improving CPU performance in standard test builds. (5683154)
  • Cached gpu::CollectDawnInfo() results per GPU process lifetime to eliminate multi-second hangs when repeatedly loading chrome://gpu. (2ffdf56)

2026-10-21

Summarized by glm-5.3-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-10-21

Overview

On 2026-10-21, the Chromium main branch received 899 commits, of which 741 were relevant to embedders and browser developers (first commit: https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/(8fe8d65), last commit: https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/(c83f6c5)). This was a heavy day for API removals: the Shared Storage teardown, Top-Level Storage Access cookie plumbing, First-Party Sets internals, GCM account-mapping interfaces, and the legacy DOM distiller were all deleted from stable public surfaces. Embedders should also review the declarativeNetRequest ruleset format bump, the chrome.debugger CDP restriction, the base::FeatureList callback signature change, and the ContentBrowserClient child-module/sandbox API rework.

⚠️ Breaking Changes — Public API Removals

  • ⚠️Shared Storage API teardown: public ContentBrowserClient hooks OnSharedStorageWorkletHostCreated() and OnSharedStorageSelectURLCalled() deleted; BrowsingDataModel::StorageType::kSharedStorage and kSharedStoragePath removed; SharedStorageBudgetMetadata removed from exported FencedFrameConfig structs. Embedders overriding these methods or switching exhaustively on StorageType will fail to compile. (0289254) (e3e3e05) (a431c50)
    PrivacyStorageBrowser
  • ⚠️Top-Level Storage Access cookie plumbing removed: net::CookieSettingOverride::kTopLevelStorageAccessGrantEligible, CookieInclusionStatus::ExemptionReason::kTopLevelStorageAccess, and the kAllowByTopLevelStorageAccess mechanism deleted from net/cookies, services/network mojom, and CookieSettingsBase. Custom cookie-settings implementations will break. (75b7b36)
    NetworkStorageSecurity
  • ⚠️First-Party Sets / Related Website Sets internals removed (~8,600 lines): public header content/public/browser/first_party_sets_handler.h deleted, IsFirstPartySetsEnabled()/WillProvidePublicFirstPartySets() removed from ContentBrowserClient, component installer dropped, and RWS-decided Storage Access grants now unconditionally deleted on startup. (845d377)
    NetworkPrivacyBrowser
  • ⚠️GCM account-mapping/token plumbing removed: GCMClient loses AccountTokenInfo, SetAccountTokens(), UpdateAccountMapping(), RemoveAccountMapping(), SetLastTokenFetchTime(); GCMDriver loses the same plus GetLastTokenFetchTime(); GCMClient::Delegate::OnGCMReady() signature changed to no arguments. Legacy LevelDB entries silently ignored. (ff15f22)
    SyncBase
  • ⚠️base::FeatureList runtime-mutable feature callback signature change: OnRuntimeMutableFeatureStateChangedCallback now receives bool old_is_enabled, bool new_is_enabled instead of OverrideState. New additive IsFeatureEnabledForOverrideState() method. (96102b3)
    Base
  • ⚠️ContentBrowserClient child-module/sandbox API rework (Windows): ChildModule struct and GetChildModule() removed; PreSpawnChild() signature changed; GetChildProcessPath() now takes content::ChildProcessId. Embedders must migrate to the new GetRendererSandboxPolicyExtension(render_process_id) virtual. (5860166)
    SecurityWindowsBrowser
  • ⚠️Widget::InitParams::force_software_compositing removed along with ui::Compositor::force_software_compositor() and the WindowTreeHost::CreateCompositor() parameter; FrameSinkManager mojom updated. Embedders forcing software compositing for specific widgets must rely on global fallback policy. (0435c36)
    UICompositor
  • ⚠️Legacy DOM distiller engine dropped: DistillerOptions loses its proto::DomDistillerOptions constructor; GetDistillerScriptWithOptions() removed from extraction_utils.h. Migrate to ReadabilityOptions / GetReadabilityDistillerScript(). (50ac38b)
    BrowserStorage
  • ⚠️WebSharedWorker::CreateAndStart() / StartWorkerContext() gain a required network::PermissionsPolicyFeaturesBitset parameter (permissions-policy plumbing for shared workers); new PermissionsPolicy::CreateFromInheritedPolicy() added to //network. (1c9716f)
    ServiceWorkerNetwork

Extensions & Extension APIs

  • ⚠️declarativeNetRequest host-permission enforcement for response header values: rules matching on response header values/excludedValues now require host permissions; non-host-permission matching is restricted to a CORS-safelisted allowlist. Indexed ruleset format version bumps 36 → 37 (rulesets must be re-serialized); rules requiring host permissions are skipped rather than masked. Extension ad-blockers relying on header-value matching without broad host permissions will silently change behavior. (22a2af9)
    ExtensionsNetworkSecurity
  • ⚠️chrome.debugger CDP attach restricted: Target.attachToTarget/Target.autoAttachRelated are now blocked from reaching restricted WebUI <webview> guest targets and their workers. Extensions relying on CDP auto-attach into WebUI guests will silently lose access. (a40d678)
    ExtensionsDevToolsSecurity
  • Extensions security fix: experimentalAiData API can no longer read incognito tab data via getAiData/getTextSurroundingSelection (include_incognito removed from GetTabById paths). (f264cf7)
    ExtensionsPrivacy
  • ImageWriter zstd (.zst) extraction moved out of the browser process into the sandboxed FileUtilService utility process (Rule of 2); new Mojo interfaces in chrome/services/file_util. (5550975)
    ExtensionsSecurity
  • Component extension installer generalized: ComponentExtensionInstallerPolicy refactored into a reusable config-driven policy; stale staged component extensions are now cleared when ComponentInstaller::Register() finds no valid installation (fixes chrome://newtab startup breakage). NTP component extension now registered via the installer with a real WebUI NTP page. (10bf8e6) (31b52e7) (51602f3) (cd16267)
    ExtensionsUpdaterBrowser
  • Revert of the flag-gated runtime.getDocumentId() extension API (and RenderFrameHost::GetDocumentToken() exposure) due to test failures — restores prior stable behavior. (cf2a92f)
    ExtensionsDevTools

Networking & Cookies

  • Device Bound Sessions (DBSC): federated registration requests now block all redirects to prevent JWT leakage to undeclared origins. Adds URLFetcher::SetShouldFollowRedirectCallback(), new SessionError::kFederatedRegistrationRedirected, and DevTools protocol exposure. (04e9a20)
    NetworkSecurity
  • DevTools 'Open in new tab' navigations now attributed to the inspected page with Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site and no SameSite=Strict cookies, closing a CSRF-bypass vector via console/Network panel. (d59f8fb)
    DevToolsSecurityNavigation
  • Security hardening of CreateNewWindowParams: non-empty referrer URLs must be hosted by the initiating renderer process or the renderer is terminated (RFH_CREATE_NEW_WINDOW_INVALID_REFERRER). Only affects misbehaving renderers. (fc98b05)
    SecurityNavigation
  • DOM Storage default fallback now prefers an existing backing store or LevelDB, preventing data loss if the SQLite experiment ends. (dd898c9)
    Storage
  • Windows: WGC window-capturer now falls back to the Cropping window capturer when WGC fails (kill switch kWebRtcWgcWindowCroppingFallback). (f5e8707)
    WebRTCWindows
  • SourceSpecificMulticastInDirectSockets shipped to stable (sourceAddress on MulticastController.joinGroup()/leaveGroup()); Isolated Web Apps only. (8774e07)
    Network

Security & Privacy

  • DevToolsUI privilege-escalation fix: GetTrustPolicy() returns kTrusted only for trusted local frontends; sticky untrusted-opener taint persists across DevToolsUIBindings instances. Previously remote-frontend popups could obtain local DevToolsFrontendHost bindings. (eb15651)
    DevToolsSecurity
  • DevTools blocked for TopChromeWebUIProfile (shared top-chrome WebUI renderer), preventing cross-profile data exposure; still permitted with kDebugTopChromeWebUI. (5d99976)
    DevToolsSecurityProfiles
  • macOS renderer seatbelt profile now restricts process-info-pidinfo to the renderer's own process; unrestricted access behind default-disabled killswitch MacSandboxAllowRendererPidinfo. (e24ae5a)
    SecuritymacOS
  • PWA launch-params security fix: LaunchParams::set_app_id() clears file handles when the app_id is relabeled, preventing cross-app file-handle leaks across redirects; out-of-scope launches silently dropped. (e41efb6)
    SecurityBrowser
  • Auto Picture-in-Picture restricted to the primary main frame — subframes can no longer trigger auto-PiP. (9e42f02)
    MediaSecurity
  • Fixes window.alwaysOnTopPopup state after window.open(): browser-verified values are no longer overwritten by unverified renderer requests. (5fd3bdd)
    SecurityBrowser
  • Windows: wallpaper search background writes go through temp file + rename to prevent symlink-based redirection of base::WriteFile(). (20d97d1)
    SecurityWindowsThemes
  • Windows crypto: RSA attestation identity keys now created through the Platform Crypto Provider (NCryptCreatePersistedKey) instead of raw TPM2_Create; failures surface as provider HRESULTs. (534a3a6)
    CryptoWindowsEnterprise
  • crypto::kex::X25519() made fallible (returns [[nodiscard]] bool) to handle small-order peer points producing all-zero shared secrets. (df5b66f)
    CryptoBase

Browser UI (Windows/macOS)

  • Windows 11 Direct Launch: new DirectLaunchManager registers with the shell's direct-launch API so http/https URI and Start-menu tile launches go straight to the running browser; disabled by default (DirectLaunchManager feature). (250f6ed) (1f66ffb)
    WindowsBrowser
  • Windows Background Mode fix: StartupLaunchManager 60-second lock delay fixed; registry auto-launch entries only removed on actual profile deletion, not clean exits. (a4fe27b)
    WindowsProfiles
  • macOS: main browser executable switched to the Apéritif entry point (chrome_exe_main_mac.c); libaperitif load-time linked with strict link-order verification. Build/packaging-level change for Mac embedders. (0a8aa1d)
    macOSBuild
  • macOS notifications: phantom notificationclose events (with by_user = true) on delivery failure or same-tag replacement fixed, restoring broken subsequent clicks. (6102c3c)
    NotificationsmacOS
  • macOS: stops archiving NSToolbarFullScreenWindow in restorable state, fixing NSInvalidUnarchiveOperationException crashes on fullscreen window restore. (4614eae)
    macOSUI
  • New 'Page Colors' control in chrome://settings/accessibility for forced-colors themes independent of OS High Contrast; behind disabled-by-default page-colors-settings flag. (88299f3)
    UIAccessibilityThemes
  • Windows High Contrast (forced-colors) styles added to cr-searchbox compose button and suggestion states. (f6b9fef)
    UIAccessibilityWindows
  • Tab strip refactors: TabContainerImpl collapsed into TabContainer; focus-mode API migrated to EnterFocusMode/ExitFocusMode; collapsed groups expand on range selection; Shift+Arrow selection preserves pane focus. (6eb8428) (12e5dde) (ce8a45b) (3a34914)
    TabsUI
  • Organizer panel improvements: context menu removed, media tabs pinned to top, keyboard arrow navigation via KeyArrowNavigationService, luminance-based light/dark color tokens with new ChromeColorId entries. (8b0d002) (dc88ebf) (dd3db2f) (7f17993)
    TabsUIThemes
  • FedCM ambient login: when all accounts would sign up rather than sign in, only the location-bar chip is shown. New additive virtual PermissionRequest::ShouldBubbleStartOpen() — embedders subclassing PermissionRequest should review. (62f2e40)
    UIPrivacy
  • WebUI omnibox: Ctrl+L/Cmd+L now un-elides the full URL; OmniboxPopupView::OnFocus() gained a show_full_url parameter. (5218bfb)
    UIBrowser
  • Fullscreen bubble fix: re-show-on-interaction logic now gated on tab-initiated fullscreen only, so browser/extension-initiated fullscreen no longer re-shows the exit instruction. (40354f5)
    UIBrowser
  • DeprecatedLayoutImmediately() now requires a Passkey parameter and is blocked from non-friend classes; TrackedElementWebUI offsets subframe-relative coordinates for OOP iframe/extension subframes. (b5cc6f0) (b3934b1)
    UIBrowser

Base, Storage & Core Libraries

  • ui::TreeModel/TreeModelNode become concrete classes absorbing hierarchy storage from TreeNodeModel<T>. Backward-compatible today, but the commit announces the future deletion of TreeNodeModel/TreeNode — embedders using ui::TreeNodeModel should plan migration. (5e2b824)
    UIBase
  • Blob storage hardening: BlobStorageContext now passes scoped_refptr<BlobEntry> instead of raw pointers, fixing a broad class of use-after-free bugs. (136b3f9)
    StorageBase
  • base/uuid.h forward-declares uint128 instead of including it (~94 MiB compiler input saved); downstream code relying on transitive includes may need adjustments. (2e41c49)
    Base
  • PartitionAlloc: PA_NOINLINE on LeakySingleton::GetSlowPath() (0.4–1.7% malloc throughput gain); new purge-headroom-percent SchedulerLoopQuarantine option; partition cookies gated on enable_expensive_dchecks for dcheck builds (~4% browser_tests CPU savings). (f220ed1) (fcd1596) (d22ad37)
    PerformanceBase
  • Sync hardening: DataTypeStoreImpl now CHECKs IsRealDataType() to prevent empty LevelDB key-prefix collisions; keystore_decryptor_token no longer required in keystore Nigori specifics; obsolete kSyncEncryptionBootstrapToken pref removed. (16593cd) (b9cc457) (76c5d27)
    SyncStorage
  • Windows sign-in: signin_util_win drops the legacy pre-UNO path; GCPW/Credential Provider sign-in always operates at ConsentLevel::kSignin with the History Sync opt-in flow. (0495ecc)
    WindowsProfilesSync
  • Variations: runtime-mutable seed processing delayed until MetricsService can rotate the UMA log; seed serial number synchronized with the loaded seed, fixing kFailedDeltaApply/kFailedDeltaStore after unclean shutdown. Embedders with custom VariationsServiceClient implementations should review. (3dab39e) (754669d)
    InfraBase

DevTools & Automation

  • ChromeDriver now strictly validates --allowed-origins: rejects Origin: null and empty hosts unless * is allowlisted; scheme-less host:port entries parsed as http:// with full validation. Automation setups relying on lax matching must update configs. (39b0b60)
    DevToolsTestingSecurity
  • Additive DevTools API: DevToolsAgentHostClient::GetPeerMetadata() (transport type + peer net::IPEndPoint) with a default implementation; child sessions propagate root transport metadata. Non-breaking. (dabb873)

  • chromium-bidi: excludes CDP round-trip latency from multi-click timing in input.performActions, fixing suppressed dblclick events under slow CDP. (c15c7c8)
    DevToolsTesting
  • WebMCP: fixes Latin-1 (U+0080–U+00FF) character handling in CDP tool schemas/outputs via StringUtf8Adaptor before CBOR conversion. (3521427)

Enterprise, Policy & Payments

  • Expired kProfileSignalsReportingEnabled feature removed; profile security-signals reporting is now unconditional with hardcoded 4-hour upload cadence and always-on cookie-change triggering. Enterprise admins lose field-trial param tuning. (4c350a7)

Build, Performance & Infrastructure

  • macOS build correctness fix: LC_ID_DYLIB/LC_REEXPORT_DYLIB matching in linker_driver.py fixed (leading-space mismatch caused stale .TOC files and skipped relinks); tool-file dependencies added to toolchain.gni. (a03b9de)

2026-10-20

Summarized by glm-5.3-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-10-20

Overview

On 2026-10-20, the Chromium main branch received 936 commits, of which 739 were relevant to embedders building on Chromium for Windows and macOS (ChromeOS/Ash, iOS, Android, Linux, and Blink/V8 rendering changes excluded). The day featured several confirmed breaking changes to stable public APIs — including the removal of the WindowOpenDisposition C++ enum, the treat-as-public-address CSP directive, ProcessMap::Contains(int), and signature changes to ContentBrowserClient::SelectClientCertificate(), SharedImageInterface::CopyToGpuMemoryBuffer(), AutofillClient, and extensions permission classes — plus a significant macOS Keychain encryption behavior change for non-default user data directories. First commit: (7769692). Last commit: (bcc3463).

BREAKING CHANGES

  • ⚠️Removal of the native C++ WindowOpenDisposition enum from ui/base — replaced by a temporary alias to the mojo-generated ui::mojom::WindowOpenDisposition. Embedders referencing the type must now depend on //ui/base/mojom and include window_open_disposition.mojom-forward.h. Signatures migrated across chrome/browser/ui, ash_web_view.h, and mock_tab_restore_service.h. (84278ec)
    UIBrowserExtensions
  • ⚠️Complete removal of the treat-as-public-address CSP directive from the Local Network Access implementation — the CSPDirectiveName::TreatAsPublicAddress enum value, mojom field, and exported ShouldTreatAsPublicAddress() function are all deleted. Tooling parsing CSP headers will see the directive silently ignored; replacement is the ip-address-space-override mechanism. (62b4de5)
    NetworkSecurityNavigation
  • ⚠️macOS Keychain encryption key behavior change — KeychainKeyProvider now derives a different key (alternate key tag + PBKDF2 salt) when running with a non-default user data directory, making encrypted data (cookies, passwords) incompatible between default and custom data dirs. Directly impacts automation harnesses and embedders launching macOS Chrome with --user-data-dir. (c7ee20c)
    SecuritymacOSCrypto
  • ⚠️ContentBrowserClient::SelectClientCertificate() signature change — now takes content::ChildProcessId instead of int process_id. All embedders overriding this method must update; browser-process-initiated requests now report a null ChildProcessId instead of kBrowserProcessId (0). (d49133c)
    NavigationSSLSecurity
  • ⚠️extensions::ProcessMap::Contains(int) removed — the interface now exclusively accepts content::ChildProcessId. Embedder code calling Contains() with raw ints (e.g., via RenderProcessHost::GetDeprecatedID()) will fail to compile and must migrate to GetID(). (2d3c9a0)
    ExtensionsNavigation
  • ⚠️chrome.runtime.onExtensionLoaded event semantics changed — previousVersion is now populated for reason "enable" (set to the current version), and when an install/update coincides with an enable, only the higher-precedence event fires. Extensions relying on receiving both events or on previousVersion being absent for "enable" need updates. (958dc38)
    Extensions
  • ⚠️SharedImageInterface::CopyToGpuMemoryBuffer() signature change — first parameter changed from (const SyncToken&, const Mailbox&) to (std::vector<SyncToken>, const Mailbox&), propagated through ClientSharedImageInterface and SharedImageInterfaceProxy. Embedders with custom media/video-frame integrations must update. (e0408f4)
    GPUMedia
  • ⚠️AutofillClient::SupportsDeviceReauth() virtual removed from the public interface and replaced by free function autofill::SupportsDeviceReauth(const AutofillClient&) in the new device_reauth_util.{h,cc}. Embedders implementing AutofillClient must remove overrides; TestAutofillClient::set_supports_device_reauth() also removed. (8658d68)
    AutofillPasswordManager
  • ⚠️Extensions permission API signature changes — ManifestPermission::ToValue() now returns base::Value (was std::unique_ptr<base::Value>); APIPermission::ToValue() now returns std::optional<base::Value>. Embedders with custom ManifestPermission/APIPermission implementations must update. (a8d6ae0)
    ExtensionsSecurity
  • ⚠️New ContentBrowserClient::IsContentSchemeURLNavigationAllowed() hook added and content:// navigations are now blocked by default (net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT) unless the embedder opts out via features::kBlockContentUriNavigationByDefault. Embedders overriding ContentBrowserClient must implement the new hook. (50dd531)
    NavigationSecurityBrowser
  • views::ViewShadow renamed to views::ViewDecoration across ui/views/ and chrome/ — a pure rename with minor source-compat impact for out-of-tree code using the old class name. (63a7b8d)
    UIThemes
  • TreeModel::GetIcons()/GetIconIndex() public virtuals removed from ui/base/models/tree_model.h — dead code with default implementations; only affects embedders overriding them. (311c014)
    UIBase
  • VirtualUnexportableKeyProvider and the metrics-only getter removed from crypto/unexportable_key.h (~600 lines, Windows Credential Guard implementation removed). Low practical impact as the provider was never used for key operations. (2a9a149)
    CryptoSecurityWindows

Networking & Security

  • Mojo IPC hardening on macOS — named Mach channels now support server authentication: NamedPlatformChannel::Options gains a server_process_requirement knob and ChannelMac queues outbound messages until the peer's audit token is validated (fail-closed). Defends against bootstrap-name squatting. (13391ee)
    SecuritymacOSNetwork
  • Windows TPM crypto fix — stops setting NCRYPT_PCP_RSA_SCHEME_HASH_ALG_PROPERTY on new TPM RSA keys, restoring TPM key creation on TPM 1.2 machines (broken since M152). (674e045)
    CryptoWindowsSecurity
  • Compromised eMudhra intermediates added to the certificate blocklist (net/cert/cert_verify_proc_blocklist.inc). (da63b94)
    SSLSecurity
  • CSP Embedded Enforcement now considers Trusted Types directives when validating iframe required CSP, behind the disabled-by-default CSPEmbeddedEnforcementTrustedTypes flag. (555b921)
    SecurityNetwork
  • GPU IPC validation tightened: multiplanar 16F formats with >1 channel (invalid Y_UV/Y_UV_A configs) are now rejected in shared_image_stub.cc. (25698db)
    GPUSecurity
  • Lens FetchClusterInfo()/StartFileUploadFlow() now gated on IsGoogleChromeAPIKeyUsed() — unbranded builds without official API keys skip cluster fetches and fail file uploads immediately instead of hanging. (6a408d6)
    AINetworkBrowser
  • Device Bound Sessions (DBSC) work: new RestrictedDeviceBoundSessionManager mojom interface and NetworkContext::GetRestrictedDeviceBoundSessionManager() letting a first-party Document observe DBSC sessions; plus SingleSignOnKeyManager::GenerateKey()/CanGenerateKey() for per-IdP key generation limits. (c7c2b9b) (77b23e5)
    NetworkSecurityStorage
  • Safe Browsing navigation observer fixes for retargeting/tab-id attribution in pending navigation events; plus prefs/sync infrastructure for a temporary 24-hour "No Protection" mode behind kSafeBrowsingNoProtectionTemporary. (731f0fe) (afd4d20)
    SecurityNavigationPrivacy
  • Extensions: chrome.debugger attach/enumerate is now blocked for workers in WebUI <webview> guest StoragePartitions (security restriction). (e9ee68e)
    ExtensionsSecurity
  • Fixed validation of stored super-encrypted preference hashes in pref_hash_store_impl.cc (decrypt-and-compare instead of ciphertext comparison). (c929696)
    SecurityPrivacy
  • Enterprise client certificates: adds SanitizeAndTruncateCommonName() (64-byte CAS limit), ContextDelegate::GetExpectedCommonName()/ShouldCertificateBeRenewed(), and a kClientCertCommonNameAttribute flag — preparation for managed-CN policies. (6000596)
    EnterpriseSSLPolicy

Extensions

Overview

A summary of 1007 total commits processed for the main branch on 2026-10-14, with 832 commits relevant to desktop browser environments (Windows and macOS). This report focuses on core browser features, security hardenings, extension API updates, and UI infrastructure improvements, omitting ChromeOS, mobile platforms, and low-level rendering engine modifications. Range spans from (e95a6f8) to (5fe801d).

Security & Extensions

  • Extension action popup URLs specified via manifest default_popup or programmatically set via chrome.action.setPopup are now strictly required to match the chrome-extension:// scheme, rejecting blob: or filesystem: schemes to mitigate RCE vectors. (7811f3b)
    ExtensionsSecurity
  • Enabled kRestrictGeneratedPathsInWebAccessibleResources by default, preventing wildcard rules from matching internal generated paths like _favicon. (fad4d6c)
    ExtensionsSecurity
  • Tightened initiator checks in CrossRendererResourceLoad so requests loading extension resources via DevTools are gated by browser-trusted process IDs. (c1d1650)
    ExtensionsDevToolsSecurity
  • Updated BlinkNotificationServiceImpl::ClosePersistentNotification to validate that incoming notification IDs are non-empty, preventing database crashes from fuzzed renderers. (d027f73)
    NotificationsSecurity

Browser UI & Window Management

  • Added support for creating always-on-top popup windows via renderer-requested window features, creating an ALWAYS_ON_TOP_POPUP browser instance when window_management permission is present. (afff432)
    BrowserUI
  • Decoupled WebuiOmniboxHandler from content::WebUI by passing profiles and WebContents directly, permitting non-WebUI controller hosts to instantiate the handler safely. (5a5ef6e)
    BrowserUI
  • Resolved a crash in WindowsUpdateFunction when queries executed on windows lacking tab strips or during window closure. (118c129)
    ExtensionsBrowser
  • Restored the Finder reveal workflow for manual shortcut creation flows on macOS outside of initial installation dialogs. (b238a8a)
    UImacOS

Networking, Storage & Security Services

  • Updated addAll() duplicate detection logic in cache storage to perform order-dependent comparisons using VARY headers from prior batch operations. (717fddc)
    StorageNetwork
  • Integrated OSCryptAsync encryption and decryption into LocalDomainsStorage to secure local domain files using asynchronous encryptors. (371fb4b)
    CryptoStorage
  • Enabled Windows Redirection Guard unconditionally in the elevation service framework to mitigate privilege escalation risks via NTFS junctions. (38714c0)
    SecurityWindows

Graphics, Media & Platform Integration

  • Migrated ToneMapUtil from cc::ToneMapUtil to gfx::ToneMapUtil inside the //ui/gfx:color_space component, decoupling accelerated widget components. (ff9df7b)
    GPUMedia
  • Introduced WindowServerEventPumpThread::DisableDisplayLink() in the macOS GPU process to fall back to timer-driven vsync updates if CADisplayLink fails. (f5a0ee8)
    GPUmacOS

Chromium Digest: 2026-10-13

Overview

A total of 921 commits landed, with 815 relevant to Windows and macOS Chromium-based projects after excluding Blink/webpage-processing, V8, Android, iOS, Linux, and ChromeOS-specific changes. First commit: (0620982). Last commit: (f56f1a3).

Breaking Public API Changes

  • ⚠️Adds the pure virtual StoragePartition::GetQuotaManagerProxy() method and exposes bucket-change lookup through QuotaManagerProxy. Embedders and custom browser implementations that derive from content::StoragePartition must add the new override before they will compile. (3377a85)
    StorageBrowser
  • ⚠️Renames the stable BrowserWindowInterface::Type::TYPE_PICTURE_IN_PICTURE enum value to TYPE_FLOATING without retaining a compatibility alias. Integrations using the old identifier must update their source and rebuild. (1b27f5e)
    BrowserUI

Extensions and Browser APIs

  • Adds optional canEmbed support to chrome.mimeHandler options. Existing manifests remain compatible, while embedded MIME loads now require both enabled and canEmbed; setMimeHandlerOptions() no longer requires enabled. (7c857c3)
    ExtensionsBrowser
  • Enables clipboard writes for extension service workers by default when the extension has the clipboardWrite permission, removing the need for a Finch-controlled enablement. (6eb0b84)
    ExtensionsServiceWorkerSecurity
  • Improves extension service-worker registration recovery by keeping missing workers in a registering state, waiting queued tasks for registration, and retrying failed registration without repeatedly attempting to start nonexistent workers. (2446f13)
    ExtensionsServiceWorkerProfiles
  • Corrects incognito eligibility checks for declarative rules and extension protocol handlers by consistently applying profile, manifest, component-extension, and policy state. (805a1e7) (d62ada1)
    ExtensionsProfilesPolicy

Networking and Security

  • Restores WebSocket cancellation when a server requests a client certificate but no certificate is preselected. This preserves ClientCertStore, enterprise auto-selection policy, and profile-wide certificate-cache behavior. (3cf2b1b)
    NetworkSSLSecurity
  • Restricts untrusted DevTools network overrides from modifying forbidden headers, spoofing referrers, bypassing service workers, or applying overrides to unauthorized targets and cross-origin requests. (e0b6695) (5cd7a5c)
    DevToolsNetworkSecurity
  • Cancels outstanding CORS preflights when their loader is destroyed and hardens proxy-resolution callback lifetimes, preventing resource exhaustion and re-entrant destruction failures. (2b7e971) (2ed13d0)
    NetworkSecurity
  • Enables pervasive shared dictionaries by default for cross-origin compression, improving delta-compression opportunities without changing networking APIs. (f5be834)
    NetworkPerformance

Browser UI and User Experience

  • Aligns Full WebUI omnibox focus and activation behavior with the Views omnibox, including popup focus retention, bookmark-bubble interactions, and cross-platform activation handling. (5ae9385)
    UIBrowserTabs
  • Improves macOS widget activation ordering by restoring focus before notifying activation observers, and fixes desktop focus rules so child widgets do not remain active after the host window deactivates. (cfe3129) (bade95e)
    macOSWindowsUI
  • Fixes omnibox popup lifetime handling when hidden by an external actor, preventing detached or stuck popup widgets, and avoids duplicate classic omnibox WebUI initialization to reduce renderer work. (1c64164) (2dd2034)
    UIPerformanceBrowser
  • Adds download-count badges to the WebUI download toolbar button and updates its Mojo data model, while correcting toolbar action anchoring, icon mappings, stale state, and animation resting behavior. (5529dba) (598efb5) (45b3f40) (c9d12fc)
    UIDownloadsBrowser

Browser Services, Storage, and Profiles

  • Restores immediate reads for the Device Managed Configuration API. Reads return the currently stored configuration without waiting for downloads or writes; subsequent changes continue through managedconfigurationchange. (dd7ff24) (7437800)
    BrowserProfilesNetwork
  • Adds periodic refresh for cached site tokens, clears refresh state on sign-out, and ignores stale responses received after sign-out. (178fa07)
    PrivacyProfilesSecurity
  • Limits Windows process-isolation state persistence to the default user-data directory, preventing conflicting HKCU state from non-standard profiles. (0d446af)
    WindowsSecurityProfiles
  • Migrates WebContents-owned zoom, infobar, Autofill, and session-service initialization from legacy TabHelpers attachment into TabFeatures, including handling for discarded and replaced contents. (4590613) (50758ef) (d65f7c2) (420714a)
    TabsBrowserAutofill

Payments, Autofill, and Password Management

  • Refactors payment-handler dialog sizing around SetPreferredSize() and ResizeDialogWindow(), standardizing header dimensions and simplifying navigation in preparation for custom handler window sizes. (ffe8251)
    PaymentsUI
  • Extends Autofill JavaScript detection to dynamically added fields and improves entity mergeability and deleted-profile accounting, increasing compatibility and correcting data handling. (ba43cbd) (cdd2050) (4c2829f)
    AutofillBrowser
  • Prevents extension popup crashes when focusing form fields by safely initializing Autofill, password-manager, and payment-accessory integrations, including configurations with third-party Autofill providers. (f372289)
    ExtensionsAutofillPasswordManager
  • Removes already-default password-change feature flags and strengthens validation of enabled, writable new-password fields during automated password-change flows. (68ce924) (70419d6) (79e2694) (2269237)
    PasswordManagerSecurityBrowser

GPU, Media, and Reliability

  • Hardens VideoTextureBacking handling in the canvas video renderer and removes crash-prone SQL validity checks from CDM storage so disk I/O and corruption errors follow normal database error handling. (db4fe6f) (f901af6)
    GPUMediaSecurity
  • Removes the disabled RawDraw GPU service path, including its backing, raster representation, and factory support. The unused enum value remains for compatibility with internal code. (20f233c)
    GPUBuild

Build, Tooling, and Testing

  • Moves Blink media public headers into blink_headers and removes the temporary //third_party/blink/public/platform/media GN target. Downstream build files referencing that target must update their dependencies. (4f29372)
    BuildBlinkInfra

    TestingExtensionsPDF

    BuildInfraTesting

Chromium Digest: 2026-10-12

Overview

Out of 669 commits on 2026-10-12 (main branch), 492 were relevant to Chromium-based projects. The day was dominated by AI/Actor/Glic feature work, security hardening, and large-scale build/test cleanup. Two confirmed breaking changes require embedder action: removal of the default scope argument from ActionManager::FindAction() ((89aa9ea)) and the ContentBrowserClient child-module API change ((b73ceff)). First commit: (e3c2b8b), last commit: (7a83bdf).

Breaking Changes

  • ⚠️ActionManager::FindAction() loses its default scope argument. All callers must now explicitly pass a scope (root_action_item() or nullptr) or compilation fails. Motivated by bugs from clients passing incorrect scopes; ~24 files across chrome/browser were updated. (89aa9ea)
    UIBrowser
  • ⚠️ContentBrowserClient child-module API changed. GetChildModuleVersion() is replaced by GetChildModule() returning a new ChildModule struct (version + path), and PreSpawnChild() now takes base::optional_ref<const ChildModule>. ChildModuleManager consolidated to GetLatestModule(). Windows embedders overriding these sandbox/dynamic-patching hooks must update their implementations. (b73ceff)
    WindowsSecurityBrowser

Browser UI & Tabs

  • Immersive Reading Mode content is now printed (Ctrl/Cmd+P, app menu, Basic Print) instead of the hidden underlying page. Adds printing::GetWebContentsToPrint(tabs::TabInterface*) and ScopedTabPrintTargetOverride (UnownedUserData-based). (4409372)
    PrintingTabsUI
  • Preloaded top-chrome WebUI (Tab Search, omnibox popups) is now hidden once loaded so the shared top-chrome renderer drops to background priority and gets memory purged (~5.5 MB savings). Behind a default-enabled kill-switch flag. (d92899c)
    PerformanceUI
  • GlassFrame paint optimization: skips full-view repaints on window activation when frame theme opacity is 0 (glass) and skips PaintAsActiveChanged in BrowserFrameViewMac. Performance-only. (03468d7)
    UIPerformancemacOS
  • macOS fix: BrowserView deferred focus no longer overrides a pending focus request when a tab switches in an inactive window, fixing omnibox/find-bar focus loss with Full WebUI omnibox. (ac1a9ff)
    UImacOS
  • Fixed WebUI omnibox popup race on tab switch (focus-request WeakPtr factory); URL-mirror selection contrast and narrow-window Realbox overflow fixes; omnibox reselects previously selected line after Shift+Delete match removal. (5d73e6b) (21c64ea) (2f94984)
    UIBrowser
  • Desktop app menu fix: ampersands in dynamic menu item titles (bookmarks, recent tabs, send-tab devices) are now escaped so they aren't interpreted as mnemonics; mnemonic support added for block/footer buttons. (40961ba) (7113fc9)
    UI
  • Fixed crash when ungrouping a focused ephemeral tab group (TabStripModel::RemoveFromGroupImpl re-entrancy guard); unified/vertical tab strip and organizer panel polish (unfocus button, 3-dot button, collapse positioning, recently-closed split-view restore). (58be3f2) (aacc270) (ba0d9cf) (9e88fb3)
    TabsUI
  • chrome.exe --version / --product-version now print and exit instead of silently launching a full browser process, restoring intended CLI behavior for Windows tooling. (3bdd1c5)
    WindowsBrowser
  • PWA fix: beforeinstallprompt userChoice promises left pending forever on tab switches now resolve as "dismissed" and re-arm the event. (3e83405)
    BrowserNavigation
  • Extension side panel no longer steals/traps keyboard focus from the omnibox on Windows; removed a Focus() bypass of views::FocusManager in ExtensionViewViews. (037e941)
    ExtensionsUIWindows

AI, Glic & Actor Features

  • New ActorEnterprisePolicyChecker enforces enterprise URL allow/blocklists and managed-actuation policy for Actor tasks; CreateTabToolRequest, FileUploadToolRequest, and CloseTabToolRequest registered in the Actor ToolRegistry. (645590f) (6707a57) (dbdf587) (ef4b456)
    AIEnterprise
  • ActorSurfaceHandle integer constructor made private — handles minted only by the surface registry/impl (tests use new CreateForTesting()). API tightening within the Actor component. (963e97e)
    AI
  • Glic: settings/permission and window-management APIs migrated from postMessage to direct Mojo (WebClientHandler); GlicInstanceCoordinator gains GetInstanceForConversationId/GetInstanceForTaskId (pure virtual additions — internal interface, implementers must update). (8332f6f) (9d90e33) (25c3159)
    AIBrowser
  • On-device model: adds enable_thinking/thinking_token_budget options and thought chunks to the Prompt API plumbing (additive Mojom fields). Context Hub gains new Mojo methods (CopyAttachmentsToClipboard, OpenWebUrl, OpenContextHubPage). (955890a) (fb76cd1) (17779f8)
    AI
  • browser_actuator transport: DownstreamMessageSequencer wired into sessions with reorder buffering, stream replay on overflow, and teardown after repeated invalid sequence numbers (ProcessDownstreamMessage now returns base::expected). New ExportSessionsAsJson() developer tooling. (1436fbd) (817ea8a)
    AIBrowser
  • Contextual tasks/composebox fixes: tab contextualization callbacks now resolve with nullptr on navigation (fixes stuck composebox submit button); tab ordering, skeleton loaders, and new hybrid-solution flag. (578db53) (e4c9b1e) (27470c5)
    AIUI

Networking & Security

  • Security hardening: Drive picker consent is now verified against the Footprints backend before recording consent/minting OAuth tokens, rather than trusting the untrusted renderer's relayed result; fails closed on RPC failure. (895803e)
    SecurityNetwork
  • MTC (Merkle Tree Certificates) draft plants-07 support: signer-set compatibility version bumped to 2; parsing now ignores issuers with unknown spec_version (forward-compatible hardening). (6391749)
    SSLCrypto
  • CSP behavioral correction: trusted-types-eval is now checked per-policy per spec, and Trusted Types checks run before CSP checks — trusted-types-eval is now enforced for setTimeout()/setInterval(). Sites relying on the previous leniency across multiple policies could see breakage. (4c864fd)
    SecurityHTML
  • Blocks downloads from captive-portal WebDialogView dialogs, fixing a vulnerability where network attackers could silently drop files. Adds CanDialogDownload()/set_can_download() to ui::WebDialogDelegate (additive, cross-platform). (82594fc)

Summarized by glm-5.3-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-10-11

Overview

This digest covers 22 commits on the Chromium main branch (ranging from #(1716398) to #(1716523), first commit (f41c59f), last commit (894a6b8) by position). No MAJOR breaking changes to stable public APIs were confirmed. Notable work includes an internal refactor of the Extensions windows API, a multi-part cleanup of redundant build dependencies, a blob storage paging fix, and a ShadowRealm crash fix relevant to embedders like Electron.

Extensions

  • Split chrome.windows extension functions out of tabs_api.{h,cc} into new windows_api.{h,cc} files. This is a mechanical, behavior-preserving internal refactor — the extension-facing chrome.windows API surface is unchanged; only internal C++ file organization moved. (3939f2e)
    ExtensionsBrowser

Build / Infrastructure

  • Multi-part cleanup removing redundant browser_public_dependencies from leaf targets in //chrome/browser, //chrome/browser/ui, and //chrome/test, now that //chrome/browser:browser has no sources or circular includes and //chrome/browser/ui:ui has been removed. Internal build-graph simplification; no public API impact. (d85d15e) (a819749) (91c274f) (95f693b) (bc7362f)
    BuildBrowser
  • License tooling cleanup: removed obsolete/stale SPECIAL_CASES entries from tools/licenses/licenses.py (native_client, ppapi, v8-i18n, openscreen, angle, etc.). (f41c59f)
    InfraBuild
  • Rolled src/third_party/libaom (d53e6d0b1..8fbd65b2f, 5 upstream commits including merge of libaom v3.15.2). (2fb66b0)
    MediaBuild

Storage / Performance

  • Fixed blob storage paging behavior: MaybeScheduleEvictionUntilSystemHealthy() previously paged every populated item to disk whenever paging triggered, because total_memory_usage was computed once outside the loop. Now bytes being paged are counted as evicted so paging stops once expected usage is at/below the limit, resulting in smaller, more frequent paging batches. A behavioral fix to internal storage logic, not a public API change. (2f0832d)
    StoragePerformance

Bug Fixes (Embedder-Relevant)

  • Fixed a ShadowRealm full-GC crash: Blink's GC metrics recorder hit NOTREACHED() when attributing metrics to a ShadowRealm context (resolving it to ShadowRealmGlobalScope and calling UkmRecorder()). Now returns no UKM recorder / invalid source ID for ShadowRealms. Notably referenced from an Electron issue, so this fix is relevant to embedders. (8aa7b26)
    BlinkBrowser
  • Restored mouse cursor visibility for native dialogs on Windows: native dialogs could inherit a hidden cursor when typing-hides-cursor was active, because ::ShowCursor(FALSE) in DesktopWindowTreeHostWin decremented the thread-global cursor counter and mouse events over native dialogs bypassed Chrome's event filter. Fixed by stopping legacy ::ShowCursor() calls and restoring cursor visibility in HandleCancelMode(), guarded behind features::kHideCursorWhileTyping. (a2be9ee)
    UIWindows
  • WebVTT cue layout fix: non-snap-to-lines cues with percentage line values could render below the video area after an earlier spec-conformance change removed a translate transform. Implemented the closest-position adjustment along the line axis so partially/fully clipped cue boxes stay within the rendering area. (58ed0c7)
    BlinkHTML
  • Network metrics cleanup: removed four expired ReportingAndNEL.NumberOfLoaded* histograms and their recording helpers from SQLitePersistentReportingAndNelStore. Dead code removal; no functional change to NEL/Reporting behavior. (1fb712e)
    NetworkStorage

UI / UX

  • NTP theme sync fix: normalized NTP background URL image options across platforms in theme_translation.cc so cross-platform theme equality checks, history deduplication, and Backdrop URL validation work between Desktop and Mobile. Also moved image URL option helpers into a new //components/themes/common target. (d02281c)
    ThemesSyncUI
  • Drive integration consent dialog adapted for larger screens (floating card on tablets, web contents inset, background tint, loading overlay on dismiss). Android-specific. (a3ddc14)
    UIAndroid
  • iOS Gemini infobar banner: capped dynamic font size for the CTA button and preserved multi-line/scale-to-fit settings. iOS-specific. (894a6b8)
    UIiOS

Testing / Tooling

  • Android test batching: enabled @Batch(Batch.PER_CLASS) on SettingsPageSigninTest and batched CCT/NTP sign-in promo tests with preference cleanup for faster test runs. Test-only changes. (52ec17c) (a315822)
    TestingAndroid
  • Updater tooling optimization: replaced a static base::NoDestructor map in ksadmin HasSwitch() with a constexpr base::FixedFlatMap and avoided redundant map lookups in SwitchValue(). Internal performance optimization. (94bf167)
    UpdatermacOS
  • Routine maintenance: owners file cleanup (gpu/GRAPHICS_TEAM_OWNERS) and translation XTB updates from the release translation dump. (30d6e31) (e8e86ce)
    InfraI18n

2026-10-10

Summarized by glm-5.3-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-10-10

Overview

This digest covers 68 commits landed on Chromium main between (8531890) and (8551093). No MAJOR breaking changes to stable public APIs were confirmed; the batch consists mostly of bug fixes, internal refactoring, feature-flag cleanup, UI/UX polish, and test/infrastructure changes. Per custom instructions, ChromeOS/Ash, Android-specific, iOS-specific, and Blink/V8 rendering changes are de-emphasized.

Security & Privacy

  • CRD host hardening: remote_webauthn now validates the calling extension origin for native messaging hosts, rejecting arbitrary extensions from driving the WebAuthn proxy (extension ID list moved to remote_webauthn_constants). Also on macOS, AgentProcessBroker records each agent's real UID and rejects BindChromotingHostServices() callers whose UID doesn't match the active agent, matching per-user isolation on Linux/Windows. (008b2a4) (fa7decb)
    SecurityNetwork
  • Bluetooth: ClearAdvertisementClients() now calls MaybeStopDiscovery() so BlueZ discovery sessions are released when clients are cleared on tab hide/focus loss, instead of leaving platform scans active for the tab's lifetime. (18e4f79)
    BluetoothBrowser
  • Private AI: Added certificate_util with PemToDer/PemToDerChain helpers (BoringSSL PEM tokenizer) to decode PEM X.509 certificates to DER for Private AI TLS sessions, including OakCT certificate bundles. (ca2f0ce)
    CryptoSecurity

AI & Intelligence

  • Decisions API: Added AILanguageModelDecisionModel, a blink.mojom.AIDecisionModel backend scoring options via the Prompt API's on-device foundation model (Gemma 4), with prompt building, token-quota checks, and serialized decide() calls. A follow-up routes AIManager to this backend, gated behind chrome://flags#decisions-api (experimental). (e1d526d) (a07b28e)
    AIBrowser
  • Actor/Glic: AttemptFormFillingTool now supports credit_card_opaque_token for direct form filling without the suggestion-selection dialog (Desktop and iOS), rejecting invalid combinations with kArgumentsInvalid. Also fixed stale recreation-state overrides clobbering expanded Glic shows on Android, added a glic-ssr chrome://flags entry, recorded Glic.Fre.Invoked metrics, and improved the Glic start benchmark (H2 test server, type-only imports, network-service warmup). (54ae2f1) (218b85f) (4e1ca1e) (136175f) (b0abae7)
    AIBrowser
  • iOS Gemini: Forwarded conversation-load errors through GeminiSessionDelegate/Handler/Mediator to transition to zero state on failure, and moved ForceDismissFloaty() triggers into GeminiContainerMediator. (009068a) (209e78c)
    iOSAI

Browser UI & UX

  • Menu mnemonics (ChroMenu GlowUp): ActionItem::SetText() now accepts mnemonic markers (&Find, && for literal &); GetText() returns text without the marker and a new GetTextWithMnemonic() returns it as set. MenuItemView::GetMnemonic() was fixed for &&, and action-bound menu items now show mnemonic text. Nothing sets the hooks yet in the first CL, so no immediate behavior change. (8542b55) (705e8fd) (b38624c)
    UIBrowser
  • New Tab Page: Restructured NTP HTML with a new #rhsContent wrapper div, moved the voice search dialog into it, and updated CSS breakpoints (--ntp-search-box-width, action chips) to reference RHS container width instead of @media window width. Also added a standalone beside-MVT AI Mode card layout for NTP Aurora V2 on Android. (5992fcc) (ec94dbd) (e927c26) (952c5c9) (a79c374) (e539ca5)
    UIBrowser
  • Customize Chrome side panel: Made the panel adapt to widths from 200px to 400px+ with linearly scaled padding variables, percentage-based color tiles, container-query icon hiding, and OS font-size scaling via text-size-adjust: calc(100% * env(preferred-text-scale)) on Android. (ef95508) (b3dcfb0)
    UIThemes
  • Omnibox Fusebox: Truncated popup row text to 2 lines with ellipsis and limited "Ask about this page" to ~18 characters for translation. (2f57f02) (e7f9c9e)
    UIBrowser
  • Vertical Tabs (Android): Added expand-on-hover checkmark spacing, accessibility content description for the rail resize handle, and finalized strings/TODO cleanup for the feature. (0af7275) (9c95ec0) (ced28a2)
    TabsAndroid
  • Glass Frame / NTP footer: Fixed a visual artifact where the NTP footer painted frame color until the web view loaded, by painting it to the toolbar color on load. (3f3ce40)
    UIBrowser
  • Extensions side panel: Fixed a use-after-free during window/activity teardown where ExtensionSidePanelCoordinator now deregisters its entry in its destructor and ExtensionSidePanelContentsAndroid observes host destruction, preventing dangling ExtensionViewHost pointers in SidePanelRegistry. (b122968)
    ExtensionsUI

Sync, Profiles & Preferences

  • Cross-device themes: CrossDeviceThemeTracker now matches synced themes by OS type/form factor/DataType instead of per-device GUID, replacing GetThemeForDeviceGuid with GetThemeForOsTypeAndFormFactor and removing unused DeviceInfoTracker observation and per-device fields. This is an internal API change within Chrome's own components, not a public embedder API. (2cdaa03)
    SyncThemesProfiles
  • Cross-device prefs: CrossDevicePrefTracker no longer records/propagates pref entries when the value equals the registered default and no local entry exists, fixing false "written preference" counting during startup initialization. (703e689)
    SyncProfiles
  • Journeys (History): Journey collections are now synced from the server into the local history database and resolved against the journey's visits for the details page; unmatched items and empty collections are dropped. Shared gtest printers moved to a common test-only file. (f53d33e) (1849672) (02f294b)
    HistorySync

Policy & Enterprise

  • Policy UI cleanup: Removed leftover Lacros allUsers scope code — deleted GetPolicyScope() from PolicyConversionsClient, inlined user/machine scope conversion, and removed the IDS_POLICY_SCOPE_ALL_USERS localized string and its UI mapping. This removes an internal method from a POLICY_EXPORT class but only affects the chrome://policy WebUI display path. (f796f33)
    PolicyUI

Printing & Downloads

  • Android printing: The 3-stage print lifecycle now binds the target frame's GlobalRenderFrameHostId at initiatePrint and propagates it through print()/finishPrint(), so teardown reaches the originating frame even if it navigated or entered BackForwardCache. (3f0cdf9)
    PrintingAndroid
  • WebAPK icon hashing: WebApkSingleIconHasher now uses SelectFaviconFrameIndices to pick the best bitmap frame instead of hardcoding bitmaps[0], fixing 16x16 frames being sent to the WebAPK minting server for multi-frame .ico icons. (5ef7532)
    AndroidBrowser

Autofill & Payments

  • Churned users: Centralized AccountInfo retrieval and metric logging in PaymentsChurnedUsersManager::OnFieldTypesDetermined; UI delegates on Desktop and Android now accept AccountInfo as a parameter (internal component API change). (3f0079c)
    AutofillPayments
  • Autofill: Stopped caching the scan-card check result in CreditCardScannerController to fix a crash when the condition changes after the chip is shown. Also cleaned up unused includes in AtMemory files and migrated autofill AI date formatting off direct ICU to the IcuBridge. (798b140) (fdafa1d) (e28cd5a)
    AutofillPayments
  • Facilitated Payments: Added FacilitatedPayments.Pix.AccountLinking.VideoLinkClicked UMA metric when the "See how it works" link is clicked on the Pix account linking prompt. (7f09f42)
    PaymentsAndroid

ServiceWorker & Web APIs

  • ServiceWorker fixes: Installed script decoding now flushes the TextResourceDecoder so scripts under 3 bytes and trailing incomplete multi-byte sequences decode correctly; top-level worker script encoding is now plumbed through to ServiceWorkerScriptCachedMetadataHandler::Encoding() for V8 code-cache matching (guarded by a new runtime-enabled feature). (e4b334b) (b64efbe)
    ServiceWorkerStorage
  • WebHID: Unit exponent nibble 0x8 is now correctly interpreted as -8 (4-bit two's complement) in unitExponent and unit factor exponents; previously reported as +8. (557d18d)
    USBBlink

Feature Flag Removals & Cleanup

  • Omnibox: Removed the OmniboxAsyncViewInflation feature flag and the legacy synchronous recycled-view-pool route across AutocompleteCoordinator, OmniboxSuggestionsDropdown, and PreWarmingRecycledViewPool; async inflation is now unconditional on Android. (729f746)
    UIAndroid
  • ChromeOS flags: Removed the expired flex-firmware-update flag/feature/helper (enabled by default since M142) and the kDriveFsMirroring feature flag with obsolete MirrorSync prefs (migrated to obsolete profile prefs). (799b9b9) (3c76b1d)
    ChromeOSUpdater
  • Misc cleanup: Removed unused includes in AtMemory and iOS actor tool files, removed a Dangling marker from TestSessionControllerClient, cleaned up the EnableTabSharingProtection fieldtrial testing config, and removed exit-time destructors in WaylandDataDeviceBase (return type changed to std::span). (384073d) (c2863c4) (7b25940) (587f0c8)
    BaseBuild

Infrastructure, Testing & Build

  • Crubit/Rust: Enabled assume_lifetimes by default in rust_api_from_cpp targets (lifetime elision rules applied to C++ references), added a //build/rust/crubit:cref target for CRef/CMut types, and documented lifetime annotation guidance. This changes generated Rust binding ergonomics for all Chromium Rust bindings consumers. (a6d8927)
    BuildBase

2026-10-09

Summarized by glm-5.3-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-10-09

Overview

A total of 1091 commits landed on the main branch on 2026-10-09, of which 861 were relevant after filtering. The first commit was (51eb0b3) and the last was (97c654d). The day was dominated by internal refactoring (TabFeatures migration, browser_public_dependencies cleanup), DevTools/extension API tightening, and feature work behind flags. Several changes affecting extensions, DevTools, and signin APIs do require code updates for affected embedders and extension authors.

Breaking Changes & API Removals

  • ⚠️DevTools Emulation.setTimezoneOverride and Emulation.setLocaleOverride now return a server error for untrusted sessions (e.g., extensions using chrome.debugger attached to a single tab). Tooling relying on these commands from untrusted sessions must handle the error response. (f29ad3f)
    DevToolsExtensions
  • ⚠️Legacy passwordsPrivate extension functions removed, along with the OnPasswordsFileExportProgress extension event and the EnablePasswordManagerMojoApi flag path (~982 deletions). Extensions or WebUI code using the legacy export-progress event will break. (1748ec1)
    ExtensionsPasswordManager
  • ⚠️chrome.mimeHandler.setMimeHandlerOptions()/getMimeHandlerOptions() now reject MIME types the extension does not handle instead of silently accepting them. Extension authors must ensure their manifest handlers match the requested types. (2aefb7d)
    Extensions
  • ⚠️Remote DevTools frontends no longer receive DevTools extension panels or extension API registration; AddDevToolsExtensionsToClient() and RegisterExtensionsAPI() are now gated on local frontends. Related hardening requires all live openers in the chain to be local frontends. (dfc2c70) (ba0938f)
    DevToolsSecurity
  • ⚠️AccountCapabilities Privacy Sandbox capability getters removed (can_run_chrome_privacy_sandbox_trials(), is_subject_to_chrome_privacy_sandbox_restricted_measurement_notice()) from the signin identity manager API, plus Android Java equivalents. Callers must migrate. (e952cc7)
    SyncPrivacy
  • ConfirmInfoBarDelegate::GetMessageSubstitutions() signature changed from const std::vector<MessageSubstitution>& to base::span<const MessageSubstitution>. Embedders with custom infobar delegates should verify compilation. (7073f2f)
    InfraUI
  • autofillPrivate Wallet upsert context_token changed from string to bytes with Base64 encoding at the extension API boundary — extension/WebUI code touching this data format needs updating. (8689bcc)
    AutofillPayments

Extensions

  • MIME handler embedding consolidated: can_embed is now the single source of truth and the PluginUtils allowlist bypass was dropped; disabled MIME handlers are filtered at read time, enabling per-profile enablement. An optional enabled key was added to mime_types_handler manifest entries, and options are stored as per-type records with migration from mime_handler_enabled. (0413871) (d430ba4) (4351106) (b4d2230)
    Extensions
  • Fixed a use-after-free in AppWindow::Init()/ForcedFullscreen() via AppWindow::GetWeakPtr(), with a new kPrematureWindowClose error response in AppWindowCreateFunction. (dadc0ee)
    ExtensionsSecurity
  • Chrome Remote Desktop's extension ID added to the native messaging allowlist; extension icon-width CHECK reverted to DCHECK to prevent release crashes with non-standard icons. (7b2b54b) (cec87c8)
    Extensions

DevTools & Automation

  • CDP Network.loadingFinished gains an experimental encodedBodyLength field, and chromium-bidi bodySize now reports encoded body length rather than transfer bytes. New BiDi command emulation.setTextLayoutModeOverride implemented; v8.evaluateModule trace events now include script location data. (2fd91ef) (b2f64eb) (0debe75)
    DevToolsNetwork
  • macOS automation improvement: -[RenderWidgetHostViewCocoa acceptsFirstMouse:] now returns YES for clicks posted via CGEventPostToPid() while the app is inactive, enabling assistive/automation tools to click windows without activating the app first. (212c026)
    macOSUI
  • Windows test input handling improved: InputDispatcher falls back to ::GetCursorPos to skip stale WM_MOUSEMOVE events after window detach, enabling synchronous MoveMouseTo in tab drag tests. (fef6b69)
    WindowsTesting

Security & Privacy

  • macOS sandbox hardening: GPU process WebNN permissions narrowed from broad darwin-user-temp-dir to narrow subdirectory grants (webnn_gpu_protected, MetalPerformanceShadersGraph, file-write-unlink for TemporaryItems). (5ac19a8)
    SecuritymacOSGPU
  • New feature kSafeBrowsingNoProtectionSuppressWarnings suppresses heuristic dangerous-download warnings in "No Protection" mode while preserving enterprise restrictions; tab sharing protection enabled by default; WebAuthn algorithm filtering for security keys enabled by default behind a feature flag. (d97b94a) (12f57ef) (0fab432)
    SecurityPrivacy
  • Privacy fix: failed favicon download negative cache is now cleared with browsing data, preventing history leakage/re-identification. Universal Opt-Out eligibility no longer depends on the toggle state. (afb2cc4) (04d6291)
    PrivacyHistory
  • Global Privacy Control: Blink runtime feature renamed to GlobalPrivacyControlApi and enabled when Universal Opt-Out features are on; a new user-visible Universal Opt-Out flag was added. (An earlier GPC API wiring was reverted due to build failures.) (12652e1) (435f6a7) (2d09262)
    PrivacyBlink
  • DBSC: new SingleSignOnKeyManager in net/device_bound_sessions/; TPM startup metrics deferred 45s and subsampled on Stable to avoid contending with early crypto operations. Crashpad crash attachments enabled on macOS for updater/enterprise companion. (d7c78f7) (d05f59f) (1788151)
    NetworkCryptoSecurity

Networking & Performance

  • LoadingPredictor now caps low-priority resource sets at 500 entries to bound memory growth on long-lived pages; UtfConversionAsciiFastPath enabled by default in base for modest page-load improvements. (77ccb3c) (d62e9d0)

  • Windows base improvement: FilePersistentMemoryAllocator now calls FlushFileBuffers() after FlushViewOfFile() for durable sync flushes, gated behind the new disabled-by-default kFlushFileBuffersOnSyncFlush feature. (d62c71e)

  • Glic/Actor feature work: selection overlay repositioning with new hideCloseButton property, close-reason callback, navigation throttle unification, opaque-token form filling, and new tool schemas registered (enter_fullscreen, attempt_otp_filling, perform_search, open_known_page, find_and_highlight). Autofill, Passwords & Payments

2026-09-27

Summarized by glm-5.3-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-09-27

Overview

This digest analyzes **37 commits** landed on this day, ranging from (1498cf2) down to (0784c35). After filtering out changes outside the desktop-browser scope (Blink/V8 webpage processing such as EditContext, WebMCP, WebCodecs and UserAgentData, plus Android, iOS, ChromeOS/Ash, and tvOS-specific work), **26 commits** remain relevant for projects built on top of Chromium targeting Windows and macOS. Two commits — the omnibox enum-class modernizations — are **confirmed MAJOR breaking changes** to stable APIs that embedder code compiles against. The rest consists of internal TabFeatures refactoring, Safe Browsing build-mode scoping, a series of AV1 encoder bitstream correctness fixes, macOS accessibility corrections, and stability/bug fixes.

Omnibox API Modernization (⚠ Breaking)

  • ⚠️BREAKING: AutocompleteProvider::Type was converted from a legacy unscoped C-style enum into a scoped enum class. All enumerators were renamed (TYPE_SEARCH → Type::kSearch, TYPE_DOCUMENT → Type::kDocument, TYPE_UNSCOPED_EXTENSION → Type::kUnscopedExtension, etc.) and implicit conversion to int was removed, so embedder code doing bitmask math on provider types (e.g., AutocompleteControllerConfig.provider_types) must now use explicit static_cast<int>(...). The change touched 72 files across components/omnibox/browser, chrome/browser/ui/omnibox, Ash app-list integration, and the extensions omnibox API tests. Any embedder referencing the old TYPE_* constants will fail to compile. (1d9bb5a)
    BrowserUIExtensions
  • ⚠️BREAKING: AutocompleteMatchType was converted to a scoped enum class in the omnibox namespace. AutocompleteMatch::type and related signatures changed (e.g., AutocompleteMatchType::Type match_type → omnibox::AutocompleteMatchType match_type), and all enumerators were renamed (CALCULATOR → kCalculator, SEARCH_WHAT_YOU_TYPED → kSearchWhatYouTyped, CLIPBOARD_URL → kClipboardUrl, etc.). With 205 files modified, this is the widest-reaching change of the day; embedders constructing or inspecting AutocompleteMatch objects must migrate to the new scoped enumerators. (ceb5b20)
    BrowserUI

Browser Architecture: TabFeatures Migration

  • A series of agent-generated CLs continues the migration of tab helpers off WebContentsUserData and into TabFeatures/TabFeaturesAndroid. Migrated this day: TailoredSecurityUrlObserver (safe browsing), SiteProtectionMetricsObserver, NavigationMetricsRecorder, NavigationPredictorPreconnectClient, NoStatePrefetchTabHelper, and ExternalProtocolObserver. Each lost its WebContentsUserData inheritance and FromWebContents() access (none had external callers), and instantiation moved from TabHelpers::AttachTabHelpers into TabFeatures on desktop and Android. This is internal refactoring — embedders relying on AttachTabHelpers see no API change. (636c3b1) (1d5918e) (70f4169) (59da456) (019110a) (30fa524)
    BrowserTabs

Security & Safe Browsing

  • Two CLs continue reviving builds with safe_browsing_mode=0 by scoping Safe Browsing code behind build flags. Generic HTTPS/security-state/Page Info/site-protection/search-engine-settings coverage stays available in mode 0, while password-protection and hijacking-detection paths requiring Safe Browsing services are guarded. Cloud binary upload support is retained for enterprise content analysis in mode 0 (now using the profile URL loader instead of the global Safe Browsing service), and suspicious-site UI, redirect attribution, and download-protection coverage are scoped to builds that provide their implementations. Relevant for embedders building Chromium without Safe Browsing services. (dd5257a) (201fde4)
    SecurityBuildEnterprise
  • Behavioral change (policy/enterprise): FmRegistrationTokenUploader now starts its InvalidationListener only once the CloudPolicyClient is connected (or immediately if already connected), instead of in the constructor. Previously, every desktop profile — including unmanaged and fresh signed-out ones — checked in with android.clients.google.com and registered FCM tokens at every startup that were never uploaded. Unmanaged profiles no longer register with FCM, reducing unwanted network traffic and check-ins. (89cf896)
    PolicyEnterpriseNetwork

Stability & Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a NOTREACHED crash in ThumbnailSchedulerImpl::Schedule(). ThumbnailReadinessTracker now remains in Readiness::kNotReady while a WebContents is discarded, so the empty-document load from FrameTree::Discard() no longer transitions readiness to kReadyForFinalCapture. This prevents hovering a discarded tab from requesting capture, which inadvertently triggered a reload navigation and a synchronous re-entrant SetTabCapturePriority(kNone) call. The scheduler is also hardened against state corruption: capture-priority is reset to kNone in RemoveTab() before erasing the TabNode. (4ac0142)
    BrowserUITabs
  • Fixed an in-the-wild renderer kill ([Renderer kill 123] Prefetch/IsValidCrossOrigin: frame origin mismatch) in browser-side handling of <link rel="prefetch">. Because SubresourceProxyingURLLoaderService binds a standalone, non-frame-associated URLLoaderFactory pipe during CommitNavigation(), request_initiator could legitimately differ from the frame's last-committed origin. The fix tracks did_commit_navigation in BindContext, aborts stale-initiator requests with net::ERR_ABORTED, returns net::ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT on origin mismatch without calling ReportBadMessage(), and defers EnsureCrossOriginFactory() until after origin validation succeeds. (ef7e3ce)
    NetworkNavigationSecurity
  • Reland of the fix for the bookmark manager not opening redirected URLs. After the bookmark-model migration to UUIDs, redirect lookups by legacy numeric IDs failed; a new helper maps legacy IDs to the new UUIDs. The reland replaces a real-browser test setup (which had timing issues causing WPT failures) with a faked browser instance. Changes are in chrome/browser/resources/bookmarks/router.ts and util.ts (WebUI TypeScript). (60fdad7)
    BookmarksBrowser

Browser UI

  • Code cleanup of MenuItemView in ui/views/controls/menu: a new MenuItemView::GetTrailingPadding() accessor centralizes trailing-padding semantics, GetItemHorizontalBorder() no longer special-cases bordered items, and the SubmenuView::item_horizontal_border() getter/member was removed in favor of trailing_padding(). Explicitly no change in behavior or functionality; the removed accessor is a minor internal Views metric, not a stable embedder surface. (c0bd9d7)
    UI
  • The kDefaultBrowserStickyModal field-trial flag is now only queried when the prompt-surface parameter actually selects a modal dialog, instead of unconditionally (which previously activated the trial for all clients). IsDefaultBrowserPromptSurfacesEnabled() no longer checks the sticky-modal flag, the DefaultBrowserModalUI WebUI binder is gated on the raw prompt-surface param, and DefaultBrowserSurfaceManager::Show() uses the entrypoint type so non-modal surfaces never query the flag. Affects default-browser prompt behavior on desktop. (aff6af0)
    BrowserUIWindows

Accessibility (macOS)

  • Focusable unnamed lists no longer expose their content-derived name as AXTitle on macOS. Previously VoiceOver announced the text of every item when the list received Tab focus; it now announces only the list role and item count, matching Safari/WebKit behavior. Individual items remain available when navigating inside the list. Expected-output accessibility test data updated accordingly. (f1699d6)
    AccessibilitymacOS
  • Fixed VoiceOver announcing the second and subsequent column headers of a table twice. Chromium on macOS included the current column header in its own AXColumnHeaderUIElements relationship; the current header is now excluded when collecting column headers, matching WebKit. Affects ui/accessibility/platform/ax_platform_node_cocoa.mm and macOS accessibility test expectations. (72aefe3)
    AccessibilitymacOS

Media: AV1 Encoder Bitstream Correctness

  • A six-commit series fixes AV1 bitstream writing in media/gpu/av1_builder.cc, where missing or extra syntax elements desynchronized every subsequent header field. Fixes include: writing allow_warped_motion on inter frames and skip_mode_present when the reference structure allows it; inferring error_resilient_mode, refresh_frame_flags, and frame_size_override_flag per frame type and gating use_ref_frame_mvs/primary_ref_frame/reference_select/global motion correctly; gating loop filter, CDEF, and tx mode on CodedLossless (and loop restoration on AllLossless) — reachable from WebCodecs with a quantizer of 0; moving separate_uv_delta_q into the sequence header; and terminating fixed-size leb128 padding. A fuzzer (av1_builder_fuzzer) and D3D12 encode delegate tests were updated. (380c6e4) (a33531d) (99868f2) (0046509) (15fd67d) (5a7d254)
    MediaGPU

Testing & Infrastructure

  • Reverted the Kombucha integration test NewThread_ClearsPreviousThreadTabs (contextual tasks side panel), which failed deterministically on linux-chromeos-chrome-preuprev with a kSequenceDestroyed timeout waiting for file uploads. Test-only change; no production impact. (1498cf2)
    TestingBrowser
  • Routine translation dump: XTB translation files regenerated from .GRD sources across Ash and browser resources (noted unavoidable binary-size increase). Infra/bot-commit change only. (948dcb6)
    I18nInfra

2026-09-24

Summarized by glm-5.3-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-09-24

Overview

Out of 619 total commits on 2026-09-24 (main branch), 457 were relevant to this digest. The day was dominated by a wave of confirmed breaking API removals across crypto, networking, autofill, and content public APIs, alongside significant security hardening (SRI enforcement, popup user-activation checks, Mac drag hardening), performance work (session restore, PartitionAlloc, thread priorities), and extensive feature/refactor work in browser UI, extensions, and enterprise. First commit: (62c8444), last commit: (19fcac6).

Breaking Changes

  • ⚠️Removal of crypto::SignatureVerifier — the public crypto/signature_verifier.h/.cc files are deleted entirely from //crypto. Embedders must migrate to crypto::sign::Verify/crypto::sign::Verifier and crypto::keypair::PublicKey; out-of-tree consumers will fail to compile. (d19202f)
    CryptoSSL
  • ⚠️Public net API change: net::x509_util::SignatureVerifierInitWithCertificate() is replaced by CreateSignatureVerifierWithCertificate(), returning std::optional<crypto::sign::Verifier>. The new verifier validates the public key against the signature algorithm and requires the digitalSignature key usage — stricter semantics affecting QUIC proof verification, signed web packages, and trusted vault. (0bc3f4b)
    NetworkCryptoSSL
  • ⚠️Autofill FormGroup API removal: all AutofillType-based overloads (GetInfo, SetInfoWithVerificationStatus, etc.) are deleted from AutofillProfile, CreditCard, Address, and related classes. Callers must use FieldType-based signatures (e.g., type.GetAddressType()). (3625823)
    Autofill
  • ⚠️GN visibility enforcement on chrome/browser/ui/browser.h: only //chrome/browser/ui:ui and //chrome/browser/ui/browser_window/internal may depend on it. Out-of-tree targets including browser.h directly will break at build time. (1cd5314)
    BrowserUIBuild
  • ⚠️Removal of dead Related Website Sets (RWS) metadata plumbing from the network service: public net::NetworkDelegate/NetworkDelegateImpl methods, network::mojom::FirstPartySetsAccessDelegate plumbing, RestrictedCookieManager::ComputeFirstPartySetMetadata, and FirstPartySetsPolicyService::AddRemoteAccessDelegate are removed (~3,100 deletions). Embedders overriding these NetworkDelegate hooks or wiring First-Party Sets access delegates need code updates. (b749bc4)
    NetworkPrivacyPolicy
  • ⚠️content::ChildProcessData::id (public int field) removed from the CONTENT_EXPORT struct. Embedders reading the child process ID (task managers, GPU process tracking, BrowserChildProcessObserver callbacks) must migrate to GetChildProcessId() returning the typed content::ChildProcessId. (f1d231e)
    BrowserGPU

Security & Privacy

  • SRI message signatures (Ed25519) are now enforced for Service Worker-synthesized responses, closing a bypass where forged signatures skipped network-service validation. Fails closed when expected public keys are asserted but headers/signatures are missing. (b47df21)
    SecurityServiceWorkerNetwork
  • Form-control popup widgets (select/color pickers, showPicker()) now require and consume transient user activation in the browser process, guarding against compromised renderers. Enabled by default with a PopupWidgetRequiresUserActivation kill switch. (a64fc96)
    SecurityUI
  • Mac drag hardening: drag-initiation decisions are centralized and untrusted renderers can no longer start concurrent drags or disrupt menus; adds ui/base/cocoa/drag_permission.{h,mm}. (efb4e25)
    SecuritymacOS
  • Enterprise Data Controls: a shared GetUrlFromRenderFrameHost() helper resolves URLs for about:blank/initial-empty-document popups using precursor origins, closing a policy-bypass gap for enterprise URL-matching rules. (fc9908e)
    EnterprisePolicySecurity
  • Popups whose bounds or anchor rects intersect permission-prompt exclusion areas are now destroyed/suppressed in WebContentsImpl::ShowCreatedWidget — embedders with custom popup placement should be aware. (078db04)
    BrowserSecurity
  • Enterprise download obfuscation fixes: files stranded in temp dirs, double-deobfuscation canceling downloads, and bad FileSystem URL synthesis are corrected. (5cdcd6c)
    EnterpriseDownloadsSecurity
  • The unused DIRECT_SOCKETS_PRIVATE_NETWORK_ACCESS content setting is deprecated (merged into Local Network Access); enum value marked deprecated and histogram made obsolete. (88acbaa)
    PolicyNetwork

Networking & Cookies

  • CreateDeleteCookieOnExitPredicate now snapshots cookie settings so async evaluation is safe after settings change; also handles empty predicates for session-only trust tokens. (cb7afd9)
    NetworkPrivacy
  • Cookie enums renumbered: CookieInclusionStatus::ExemptionReason (deprecated 3PCD entries removed) and CookieSettingOverride (now using EnumSet instead of manual bitmasks). Not persisted, so not breaking. (cac5eaa) (9b2a705)
    NetworkPrivacy
  • Strict structured-header parsers added to net/http/structured_headers as an additive alternative to the existing lenient parsers; zero-copy serialization via ItemView also landed. (1712544) (9b2b0e2)
    Network
