Chromium Digest: 2026-09-23

Overview

Out of 852 total commits on the main branch, 664 were relevant to this digest (first commit: (20d60c9), last commit: (71c913d)). The day was dominated by internal refactoring (Bedrock test migration, ChildProcessId migration, FindBarController UnownedUserData migration), security hardening (ML-DSA CUP signatures, Secure Gateway OAuth domain validation, DevTools delegate allowlist enforcement, Windows handle-duplication fix), and feature work around Glic/Contextual Tasks, the WebUI app menu, PDF Ink, and vertical tabs. Two confirmed breaking changes affect embedders: the update_client CrxDownloader API signature change and the removal of public FindBarController accessors from BrowserWindowFeatures.

Breaking Changes

  • ⚠️CrxDownloader API signature change: CrxDownloader::StartDownload() / StartDownloadFromUrl() now require a ProgressCallback parameter, and set_progress_callback() was removed entirely. Embedders and downstream update-client consumers must pass a progress callback (or base::DoNothing()) and can no longer set it out-of-band. This also fixes fallback downloaders not receiving progress updates. (65a5621)
    UpdaterNetworkAPI
  • ⚠️BrowserWindowFeatures public accessors removed: the public GetFindBarController() and HasFindBarController() accessors were removed from BrowserWindowFeatures. Embedder code calling these must migrate to FindBarController::From(BrowserWindowInterface*), which now uses UnownedUserData on BrowserWindowInterface. (6126eaa) (99f9595)
    BrowserUIAPI

Networking & Security

  • The network time component now requests and verifies ML-DSA-44 (post-quantum) signed CUP responses, replacing ECDSA, following a successful Finch for component/extension updates. Request keys now use cup2key=ML-DSA-44-<version>:<nonce>. Protocol migration only; no API change. (292087c)
    NetworkSecurityCrypto
  • Secure Gateway OAuth hardening: EnterpriseNetworkAuthService::FetchAccessToken now requires a destination_url parameter and rejects non-allowlisted servers (new TokenFetchError::kInapplicableServer, surfaced as kFailedBlocked); adds IsDestinationAllowedForScope domain validation and a ScopedExtraAllowedDomainsForTesting RAII helper. (0c4d055)
    EnterpriseSecurityNetwork
  • DevTools target allowlist enforcement: fixed multiple bypasses of the DevToolsManagerDelegate target allowlist — /json/activate and /json/close HTTP endpoints now return 403 for forbidden targets, WebSocket upgrades are checked during the handshake, and persistent sessions are re-evaluated on every navigation with unauthorized inspectors eagerly detached. (d3213f4)
    DevToolsSecurity
  • Windows performance fix: eliminated ::DuplicateHandle() on the UI thread (source of 1.4s–20s stalls under third-party security software). ChildProcessLauncherHelper now caches the child handle on the launcher thread; adds Windows.DuplicateProcess.Duration.{UIThread,OtherThread} metrics and warnings on base::Process::Duplicate(). (03788be)
    WindowsPerformanceBase

    WindowsSecurityPolicy

Chromium Digest: 2026-09-21

Overview

On 2026-09-21, the Chromium main branch received 693 commits, of which 545 were relevant after filtering. The day included several breaking changes to stable public APIs: privatized ClipboardEndpoint constructors in the content public API, removal of GLES2Interface::DidGpuSwitch(), a target_network parameter added to the WebSocket NetworkContext Mojo API, and removal of the RWS cookie exclusion reason from net::CookieInclusionStatus and the DevTools protocol. First commit: (2f7bcb7), last commit: (02b40e4).

Breaking Changes & API Updates

  • ⚠️BREAKING: The public content::ClipboardEndpoint API had its two- and three-argument constructors privatized, replaced with named static factory methods ClipboardEndpoint::ForUnloadedTab() and ClipboardEndpoint::ForFrame(). Embedder code constructing ClipboardEndpoint directly will fail to compile and must migrate to the new factories. (23ddcb7)
    BrowserUI
  • ⚠️BREAKING: Removed GLES2Interface::DidGpuSwitch() from the GPU command buffer client interface, along with related GPU-switch tracking in DrawingBuffer. Embedders implementing custom GLES2Interface subclasses or overriding this method must update their code. (17a3918)
    GPUCompositor
  • ⚠️BREAKING: network::mojom::NetworkContext::CreateWebSocket gained a new target_network parameter, and WebSocketConnectorImpl::ConnectCalledByContentBrowserClient gained a net::handles::NetworkHandle parameter. 2026-09-20

Summarized by glm-5.3-flash Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-09-20

Overview

This digest covers 30 commits landed on 2026-09-20 (first: (25fe36a), last: (30010bf)). After filtering per custom instructions (excluding ChromeOS/Ash, iOS, Android, and Blink/V8 webpage-processing changes), the relevant commits focus on browser UI refactoring, security hardening in fullscreen/context-menu handling, media API cleanup, and test infrastructure. No major breaking changes to stable public APIs were confirmed.

Browser UI & Build Refactoring

  • A multi-part series splits browser_view.h out of the //chrome/browser/ui:ui monolith into its own GN target (browser_view_header), fixing circular dependencies for the ~700 files that include it. browser_view.h no longer transitively includes unload_controller.h or intent_picker_bubble_view.h; signatures now use DownloadCloseType directly and apps::IntentPickerAppInfo instead of IntentPickerBubbleView::AppInfo. Companion CLs added standalone targets for browser_widget.h and contents_container_view.h, and fixed include-what-you-use across direct and transitive includers (1078 files reach browser_view.h indirectly). No behavior change, but embedders relying on browser_view.h as an umbrella header may need explicit includes. (321684d) (6f9e867) (aacc5db) (60abad7) (7bb5c2a) (d27a608)
    UIBuildBrowser
  • Omnibox OmniboxHeaderView was simplified to pass a ui::ColorId directly to views::Label::SetEnabledColor(), letting the label handle theme changes automatically instead of overriding OnThemeChanged(). (87d2dbe)
    UIThemes
  • Composebox webui components now render secondary_text_placement (BELOW_PRIMARY_TEXT) as a second row when is_two_row_suggestion is set, adding layout and CSS support for rich suggestions. (6672b03)
    UIBrowser

Security & Fullscreen Behavior

  • Modal dialog blocking now prevents tabs from entering or re-entering HTML fullscreen: BrowserWindowModalDialogDelegate::SetWebContentsBlocked() uses WebContents::ForSecurityDropFullscreen() and retains the returned ScopedClosureRunner per-WebContents for the duration of the block. The delegate now also implements TabStripModelObserver to clean up fullscreen blocks when blocked tabs are closed or replaced. This is a behavioral hardening of stable fullscreen handling on Windows/macOS. (9dcb787)
    SecurityUIWindows
  • OOPIF context menu actions (CopyImageAt, SaveImageAt, etc.) now execute at the renderer-reported clicked point cached in RenderFrameHostImpl, instead of re-mapping root coordinates that could silently fall back untransformed when an iframe is hidden or moved. Silent fallbacks in TransformPointToTargetCoordSpace() and UnboundedSurfaceWindow::RouteWebPointerEvent() now drop on failure, preventing actions from being redirected to unintended elements in cross-origin frames. (28b80f7)
    SecurityNavigation

Media API Cleanup

  • Removed the deprecated pointer/size overload of H264Parser::FindStartCodeInClearRanges from the MEDIA_EXPORT header; all internal callers now use the base::span variant. Embedders calling the old pointer-based overload would need to migrate, but this was a long-deprecated overload with no remaining in-tree callers. (bbae873)
    Media

Autofill & Password Manager

  • Autofill correctness fixes: OmniboxAutofillDelegate now binds FormGlobalId/FieldGlobalId by value in callbacks (members may change over the callback lifetime), and PasswordManualFallbackFlowTest passes correct global IDs through ShowAndAcceptSuggestion(). Test-only changes otherwise. (706679b) (3b32f5a)
    AutofillPasswordManager

Testing & Test Infrastructure

  • Ash browser test cleanup replaced namespace-scope mutable constants with constexpr values and removed -Wexit-time-destructors opt-outs across five browser_tests targets (ChromeOS-specific). (25fe36a)
    TestingChromeOS
  • New TTC (test) infrastructure adds a full end-to-end browser test harness with real App/Core components and mocked AudioManager/TtcBackend, plus a cleanup making TtcMesClient observer binding consistent between tests and production (observer passed via Connect instead of constructor). (4558074) (a6b6151)
    TestingAI
  • Test reliability fixes: AppMenuIconControllerTest scheduled-restart test now expects Severity::kLow on unstable channels; a flaky Android ContextMenuTest was fixed by unregistering observers in tearDown; the document-PiP mouse-exit activation test was made deterministic using a Views mock activation controller (re-enabling the Linux regression); and Chrome importer tests migrated C-style arrays to std::array/base::span as part of spanification. (7703969) (a71040d) (2328367) (3828065)
    TestingUI

Miscellaneous & Third-Party

  • Android AtMemory bottom sheet now preserves a partially typed search query when the sheet is closed (Android-specific, noted for completeness). (d661926)
    AndroidAutofill
  • Android NTP customization color getters now return @Nullable Integer instead of sentinel -1 values to avoid collision with Color.WHITE; NtpThemeColorInfo.COLOR_NOT_SET was removed (Android-specific). (b39bd66)
    AndroidThemes
  • Built-In AI WebDX feature enum names were corrected (kLanguageModel → kLanguagemodel, kLanguageDetector → kLanguagedetector) to match W3C web-features IDs, and missing WEB_FEATURES.yml files were added for languagemodel, languagedetection, and translator WPT directories. (7f08e3c)
    AIInfra
  • A libusb patch was applied to free cached devices on macOS USB unplug (importing upstream darwin_deref_cached_device fix), resolving a device leak on device detach. (30010bf)
    USBmacOS
  • iOS Gemini settings suggestions subpage gained informative sections and a sync-settings link (iOS-specific, noted for completeness). (5233c11)
    iOSUI

2026-09-19

Open Standalone Page

Chromium Digest: 2026-09-19

Overview

A total of 61 commits were analyzed across the codebase, with changes focused on Desktop platforms (Windows and macOS). The commits include security hardening for extension script execution, desktop browser UI cleanups, session management crash fixes, D3D12 media encoding extensions on Windows, and stability improvements across GPU framebuffers and Omnibox components. Key commits range from (5007f59) to (fe3b691).

Security & Permissions

  • Prevented extension script injection execution on prerendered non-primary main frames when extension host permissions are withheld. (65257bf)
  • Integrated views::InputEventActivationProtector into the extensions menu site access toggle to prevent accidental clicks during page transitions and layout shifts. (973f483)
  • Marked navigations initiated from the HaTS survey dialog as renderer-initiated with precursorless opaque origins to avoid bypassing navigation security throttles. (efabd3f)
  • Fixed initiator parameter propagation in WebViewGuest::OpenURLFromTab so guest-view navigations retain accurate initiator context. (c771845)
  • Prevented marking GPU framebuffer attachments as cleared when lazy clear fails under VRAM pressure, preventing potential cross-origin memory disclosure. (cb7ce88)

Browser UI & Window Management

  • Added keyboard support (Shift + Arrow keys) to sequentially extend tab range selections in TabStrip for both horizontal and vertical modes. (f9d707a)
  • Refactored LocationBar access to route directly through BrowserWindow::FromBrowser() and removed intermediate accessor shims from BrowserWindowFeatures. (97ad96a) (cc4d224) (9a1eb9b)
  • Eliminated visual flicker during transitions between the AIM popup and Full WebUI Omnibox popup, and preserved user input and selection states across focus transitions. (86394bc) (f2cb9f8) (53a4063) (49c0536)
  • Fixed a transient white flash during macOS glass-frame window deactivation by synchronizing glass view destruction with compositor frame presentation. (c26ffbe)
  • Linked App Menu zoom controls and default browser actions to Action Item states, and added sync preferences for auto-pinning toolbar actions. (09db4c4) (161aa50) (4c92a73)

Media, Graphics & GPU

  • Added support for HEVC range extension formats (4:2:2 and 4:4:4 profiles) to the Windows D3D12 hardware video encoder and added dynamic video processing format probing. (049dab2) (1d8b843) (b415ec5)
  • Fixed a negative-size memory underflow and heap corruption crash in cc::ListContainerHelper and Viz overlay processor by preventing duplicate occluding mask candidates. (5d3262a)

Sessions & State Management

  • Deferred encrypted session writes until OSCryptAsync is ready, eliminating session command deduplication bugs and commands_since_reset_ invariant crashes. (6bb217d)
  • Updated session restore logic to track and restore closed tabs to their original index within saved tab groups. (18efd0a)

Autofill & Passwords

  • Clamped password manager form field bounding boxes to the local root coordinate system to prevent cross-origin mis-anchoring of popups. (e74b6ee)
  • Refined Save and Fill dialog UX to show validation errors only when an input loses focus, made CVC fields mandatory, and enforced HTTPS URLs for password sharing recipients. (73111ac) (7f5a1bf)

Developer Tools, Mojo & Core Infrastructure

  • Unified ChromeDriver asynchronous script timeouts around the DevTools deadline clock and ensured qualified DOM tag names are built with prefixes per WebDriver specification. (a8a5468) (852d53b)
  • Added Mojo C++ helper functions and constructors to support bi-directional Message passing and handle ownership transfer with Rust bindings. (ecef6b0)
  • Decoupled CBOR dependencies from //crypto into a separate cose source set to reduce compilation dependencies on the build critical path. (5f117d4)
  • Introduced DecorationSpec and DecorationGenerator C++20 concepts into ui/decoration to enforce compile-time equality and ordering requirements. (f93ba6f) (78a9a52)

Chromium Digest: 2026-09-18

Overview

On 2026-09-18, there were 950 total commits, with 781 relevant to Chromium-based projects. The first commit was 85b20bf3e5ffd3600afa1224fbba8fd58696f996 and the last was 2528a2d1fac9ee3ecc11b5a9a9a9df346d77b767. This digest focuses on changes impacting developers on Windows and macOS, excluding ChromeOS, iOS, Android, and Blink/V8 rendering.

Breaking Changes

Chromium Digest: 2026-09-13

Overview

This digest covers 21 commits analyzing changes across desktop browser UI, extensions security, audio infrastructure, and automation for Chromium projects. From the analyzed range starting at (d52f8a4) to (c135e39), no major breaking changes to public embedder APIs were identified.

UI & Browser Views

  • Optimized startup and rendering performance in the ChroMenu desktop app menu redesign by delay-loading dynamic submenu views until needed, and polished layout alignments for custom borders, shortcut placements, and edge-to-edge menu actions. (04395db) (91b06b6)

Extensions & Security

  • Restricted Isolated Web App (IWA) deep-link navigations by disallowing isolated-app:// URLs in the chrome.history extension API, excluding them from persistence, and cancelling auto-bookmark navigation transitions. (286508d)

Media & Audio

  • Migrated AudioSystem thread-safety checks from base::ThreadChecker to base::SequenceChecker across media service implementations to align with sequence-bound asynchronous Mojo backends. (02967f9)

DevTools & Automation

  • Added support for propagating userContext across WebDriver BiDi context creation responses, navigation lifecycle events, realm descriptors, and network parameters. (4b1be76)

Storage & Infrastructure

  • Improved stability in CacheStorage backend teardown by gracefully handling closed states in CloseImpl, and cleaned up deprecated EffectiveStorageAccess metrics. (2d7d0d9) (aa0b558)

Chromium Digest: 2026-09-12

Overview

Analysis of recent Chromium commits covering Windows and macOS production builds, focusing on Content embedder APIs, browser UI refactoring, extension management, networking, and security improvements.

Content Embedder APIs & Core Infrastructure

  • ⚠️Removed base::Process and accessors from content::ChildProcessData and updated BrowserChildProcessObserver::BrowserChildProcessLaunchedAndConnected signature. (397f322)
  • Routed ParseManifestFromString through PageManifestManager and ManifestManagerHost to enforce browser-side security validations. (fb23fc5)
  • Added CrossProcessFrameConnector validation checks to RenderFrameProxyHost IPC handlers. (2836d72)

Extensions & Policy Management

  • Enabled the kApiTabsSplitView extension API flag by default. (250120b)
  • Bypassed policy update downloads for blocked extensions in low-trust environments. (e2b859b)
  • Blocked installation of policy-configured search engine and NTP override extensions in low-trust environments. (a028edf)

Browser UI & Views

  • Removed the default global keyboard shortcut assigned to Omnibox Everywhere on initial installation. (37b30fe)
  • Ensured hidden scrollbars report 0 layout width in views::ScrollView. (ef0027d)
  • Advanced Project Bedrock modularization of leaf UI targets out of //chrome/browser/ui. (9cf433a) (512bf47) (52f463f)
  • Added profile submenu support, fuzzy search items, and status chip views for ChroMenu. (fddd40b) (b0f8a8a) (18130a8) (d7b8bbc) (a17b453)
  • Automatically closed web app detailed install dialog when origin label is occluded. (229f682)

Networking, Security & Printing

  • Prevented restarting network cache transactions after response headers have been received. (e45d6f9)
  • Migrated ChromeCompaneroLoader to sequence-bound mojo::Remote. (db1edf8)
  • Added strict span validation and boundary checks for PostScript EMF GDI comment records. (91c5000)
  • Updated Windows language selector helpers to map legacy codes correctly using LanguageTag. (59f54d8)

WebUI & Settings

  • Migrated Safety Hub, relaunch confirmation dialog, and Glic subpage to Lit. (f119575) (d78e570) (b90ddd5) (4d90e9d)
  • Added Organizer panel split-view tab title display and side panel toolbar Mojo services. (cfdc9b4) (6aaf7a0) (0d53d1d)
  • Persisted remembered AI overlay notes across resets in Profile preferences. (bf026cd)

Performance & Components

  • Optimized Autofill FieldClassificationModelEncoder vocabulary memory using a tight dictionary buffer. (722a94c)

Infrastructure, Tooling & Build Cleanups

  • Enforced raw_ptr in std::variant and fixed RAW_PTR_EXCLUSION handling on type aliases. (4688902) (d8536eb)
  • Cleaned up obsolete feature flags and expired histograms. (de14dac) (7a9d7ba) (31936d2) (326ed56)

Chromium Digest: 2026-09-11

Overview

Summary of 921 total commits on the main branch, filtering for 712 relevant changes targeting desktop browser infrastructure, security, APIs, extensions, networking, and core Windows and macOS support. Spanning from commit (7e388ce) to (f81c2d0).

Extensions, Security & Spoof Prevention

  • Hardened chrome.cookies.getPartitionKey in CookiesGetPartitionKeyFunction to validate target frames via ExtensionTabUtil::IsWebContentsInContext(), preventing non-incognito extensions from resolving incognito frames. (e39e441)
    ExtensionsSecurityPrivacy
  • Added Cyrillic small letter EM (U+043C, м) to the Cyrillic whole-script-confusable set in IDNSpoofChecker to force lookalike domains into Punycode. (ed9bb20)
    SecurityI18n
  • Appended text/pdf to the opaque-blocklisted MIME types list in Opaque Response Blocking (ORB) for uniform protection. (0d54ca0)
    SecurityNetwork
  • Ensured showing the Global Media Controls (GMC) presentation picker acquires ForSecurityDropFullscreen() to block HTML fullscreen and prevent pixel-spoofing attacks. (f1b87a6)
    SecurityUIMedia
  • Added IsWebContentsForegroundAndVisible() checks before showing the native share UI on Windows and macOS to prevent background tabs from triggering system share sheets. (6fcc843)
    SecurityUIWindowsmacOS
  • Required explicit flow_id matching in DrivePickerHostUI to prevent compromised WebUI renderers from bypassing user consent. (a5b1d40)
    SecurityUI
  • Removed the deprecated relatedWebsiteSetsEnabled property from the chrome.privacy extension namespace. (824ef55)
    ExtensionsPrivacy
  • Restricted WebUSB device landing page URL validation strictly to HTTP(S) schemes to prevent crafted devices from triggering system notifications for internal privileged schemes. (6a57e20)
    ExtensionsUSBSecurity

Desktop Browser UI & Omnibox

  • Added virtual focus navigation and keyboard interaction support for the contextual entrypoint button in Omnibox Everywhere. (5744e15)
    UIBrowser
  • Fixed macOS accelerator string formatting in settings so that Option key shortcuts display as Option rather than Alt. (6af4d92)
    UImacOSI18n
  • Restored searchbox input focus upon window activation when no modal is open and ensured clean release of ScopedKeepAlive handles. (e299f19) (453d3b6)
    UIBrowser
  • Migrated Safety Hub WebUI components (safety_hub_page, safety_hub_entry_point) to Lit. (29df81c)
    UIBrowser
  • Implemented ghost loader overlay inside the side panel view to deliver visual feedback during search result loading. (b772ae2)
    UIBrowser
  • Split TabGroupStyle into a headless base utility and a Views-dependent class in preparation for unified cross-platform tab strip layouts. (8277d76)
    UITabs

Core APIs, Performance & Platform Internals

  • Extended CrashReporterClient with virtual hooks to allow downstream embedders to control upload rate limiting, gzip compression, and extra process annotations. (14cf174)
    BaseBrowserUI
  • Added support for isolated browser restarts by transferring restart responsibility to the stub process using Job Objects and custom exit codes. (f7fec01)
    BaseBrowserWindows
  • Enabled CrashMemoryMetricsReporterImpl and shared memory OOM metric collection across all desktop platforms to report renderer OOM crashes via the Reporting API. (3994479)
    BasePerformanceSecurity
  • Extracted a secure file utility to write print preview PDF output to a temporary location before safely moving it to the destination, avoiding timestamp preservation bugs from in-place truncation. (7d23cf8)
    PrintingUIBrowser

Networking & Security Policies

  • Made the speaker-selection permissions policy feature unconditional by decoupling it from the runtime-enabled flag for Isolated Web Apps. (22b6d21)
    PolicySecurityNetwork
  • Introduced QuicSocketSendBufferSize feature parameter to allow dynamic sizing of client socket send buffers instead of hardcoding fixed packet lengths. (63d928c)
    NetworkPerformance
  • Strengthened WebAuthn related-origin redirect validation checks to mandate HTTPS schemes across all redirects. (5f58dd9)
    SecurityNetwork
  • Clamped renderer-supplied popup bounds and sizes to the display work area to prevent integer overflows and malformed window dimensions from compromised renderers. (a605012)
    SecurityGPUUI
